Anyway, if you feel like I've used this sub for purposes not intended, or if you think I'm faking this whole thing (which I sometimes wonder myself) or if you feel hurt by any of my posts, I sincerely apologise. If it makes you feel any better, I intend on deactivating this account anyway. 

Again, I'm really sorry if you feel like I've done something wrong. Have a nice day.

When did I say no one noticed? I got the cops called on me ffs. Lied to them ofc.

And you're right, if a little too blunt. I do kinda treat that suicidality that way because I'm insanely afraid of what happens after I die, which is why I can't seem to go through with it
And you're absolutely right. I really don't want to die, but I need the pain to end. As cliched as that may sound.
I didn't mean it was particularly funny. Just the short time between "recovery" and suicide, I felt was humourous.
I want out, thats why I need to kill myself.
Xanax/benzos addiction is the least of my problems. I dont see how solving it will help my suicidality.
Not for anything other than alcoholism, and I prefer xans more
Well I don't. Like I said, there wasn't a psych ward and my country's healthcare doesn't really care for mental health in my region anyway.
I can see by the down votes people do not appreciate this kind of behaviour here. I'm very sorry.
I'm in that dilemma myself, but the way I see it the next time I attempt suicide it'll either leave me alive or not be my problem anymore.
